name: help-circle-dashed
description: A dashed circle containing a question mark.
useCase: Show an unresolved question or a status needing clarification.
misuse: Describe the actual status in text; a dashed border alone does not define it.

16.reason: The complete question hook is widened to keep its open mouth clear; the dot and full dashed frame retain their gaps.

24.reason: The widened full hook, separate dot and full dashed frame retain open gaps at interface size.
